t.en: Auto applies rules one at a time and bogs down as goals grow. An <wiki-ref to="automation"></wiki-ref> takes another road: to prove C, assume ¬C and look for a contradiction among the hypotheses. Isabelle’s Sledgehammer hands goals to provers of this kind.

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that turns each goal into ⊥, with the negation of what was to be proved among the hypotheses.

hint.en: <part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref> turns C into ¬¬C, that is, ¬C → ⊥.
